t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are four pairs of gnomes and you need to work out which is the best gnome in each pair. The gnomes are changed in every round, so this exercise needs to be repeated for each round.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are in four pairs in each round. For each pair you have to find which gnome provides the best result. The best gnome usually gives at least +5 mushrooms or +30 mushrooms (depending on whether it is x1 or x5). You will learn which is the best gnome in each pair. You will notice that at some point the amount of mushrooms starts to drop off, and at this point you should swap to the other gnome in the pair.
